after: Figure 32: Replenishment Recommendation  	During initial system deployment at Shalom Store, the Demand Forecast and Replenishment Recommendation modules display 'Unavailable' for expected 28-day AI sales and categorize products under 'Needs More History' in the Forecast Data Readiness workspace. This reflects the system's cold-start safeguard: because Shalom Store previously used manual physical logbooks without digitized item-level daily sales histories, RetailMind first collects live POS sales transactions until a product reaches the minimum 56-day history threshold.
